<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Defs>

  <!-- ================================= 7.92x57mm Mauser Bullet ==================================== -->
  <ThingDef ParentName="BaseBullet">
    <defName>Bullet_MauserRifle</defName>
    <label>7.92x57mm Mauser Bullet</label>
    <projectile>
      <damageDef>Bullet</damageDef>
      <damageAmountBase>26</damageAmountBase>
      <stoppingPower>1.7</stoppingPower>
      <speed>88</speed>
    </projectile>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Projectile/Bullet_big</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
    </graphicData>
  </ThingDef>

  <!-- ================================= Gewehr 41 (m) ==================================== -->
  <ThingDef ParentName="BaseHumanMakeableGun">
    <defName>OH_G41m</defName>
    <label>Gewehr 41 (m)</label>
    <description>The Gewehr 41 (m) stands as a product of Germany's aspirations for semi-automatic infantry rifles during World War II. It introduced a gas-operated system that facilitated automatic cycling of firing, extraction, and ejection processes. This innovation allowed for quicker follow-up shots compared to traditional bolt-action rifles. Despite this advancement, the rifle faced challenges in production due to its complex engineering, which limited its availability on the battlefield.
